title: Ember Campfires
description: A simple resource pack changing all campfires' inventory icons to be unlit while still showing their flame color. Supports several popular mods!
body:
A simple resource pack inspired by Raspberry Flavoured that changes all campfires' inventory icons to be three dimensional and unlit while still showing a preview of their flame color. Made for use alongside mods that change campfires to be unlit by default (such as Unlit Campfires and Hardcore Torches).

Currently supports both vanilla campfires, as well as Caverns and Chasms' cupric campfire, JNE's ancient campfire, Infernal Expansion's glowlight campfire, Endergetic Expansion's ender campfire, Dungeon's Delight's living campfire, and Nether Descent's pendorite campfires.

Originally made for my in-progress modpack Natural Oddities, but I may add any modded campfires I've missed at a later date.
